remarks: Charming & Sun-Drenched 2-Bedroom Apartment recently painted in the Heart of Norwalk - Ideal for Commuters! Welcome to 247 Flax Hill, where charm meets convenience in the vibrant heart of Norwalk! Just steps from the train station, this bright and airy 2-bedroom apartment is perfect for commuters and anyone who appreciates the energy of a walkable, lively neighborhood. Inside, the sun-filled living area features gleaming hardwood floors, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The eat-in kitchen is perfect for enjoying your morning coffee. A beautifully appointed dining room completes the space, ideal for intimate dinners and those holiday gatherings. Step outside and discover all that Norwalk has to offer - walk to local cafes, restaurants, and shops. For outdoor enthusiasts, nearby parks, scenic walking trails, and the waterfront await. With easy access to major highways, shopping, and Norwalk's stunning coastline, you'll experience the perfect balance of peaceful living and urban convenience. Additional amenities include washer and dryer hook-ups in the basement and one covered parking space included with rent. Don't miss the opportunity to make 247 Flax Hill your new home.
